Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The experiment is a metaproteomics study of the human gut microbiota. It uses a standard DDA bottom-up approach with label-free quantification (maxLFQ). While the study focuses on optimizing cell disruption and sample processing, the MS analysis itself is a standard DDA-LFQ workflow applied to a complex microbial community.

scope: the microbial pellet was resuspended in 500 μL lysis buffer (4% SDS (w/v) in 50 mM Tris–HCl buffer pH 8.0) followed by incubation in a Thermomixer Comfort (Eppendorf) at 95°C for 10 min with agitation.
Bead beating was carried out using a FastPrep-24 machine
four sonications (30 s each with 1 min interval on ice) using Vibra Cell Sonicator (Sonics & Materials Inc., United States) with an amplitude of 40% were carried out.
The resulting washed pellet was subjected to protein extraction.
